specialRules.name: Precise
specialRules.description: Gets +1 to hit when attacking.

specialRules.name: Unique
specialRules.description: This unit may only be taken once per army.

specialRules.name: Destructive
specialRules.description: On unmodified results of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+4).

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Ambushing Piercing Shot
specialRules.description: Counts as having Ambush, and its weapons get AP(+1) when shooting on the round in which it deploys via this rule.

specialRules.name: Shielded
specialRules.description: Units where all models have this rule get +1 to defense rolls against hits that are not from spells.

specialRules.name: Shred
specialRules.description: On unmodified results of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.

specialRules.name: Precision Fighter Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get +1 to hit rolls in melee.

specialRules.name: Melee Evasion
specialRules.description: Enemies get -1 to hit rolls in melee when attacking units where all models have this rule.

specialRules.name: Scrapper Boost Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Scrapper Boost.

specialRules.name: Scrapper Boost
specialRules.description: If this model has Scrapper, when it shoots or charges enemies over 9" away, enemies taking hits from it must re-roll successful unmodified defense results of 5-6 from Scrapper (instead of only on 6).

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Shooter Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Unpredictable Shooter.

specialRules.name: Scout Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Scout.

specialRules.name: Bounding
specialRules.description: When this unit is activated, you may place all models with this rule in it anywhere fully within D3+1" of their position.

specialRules.name: Surge
specialRules.description: On unmodified results of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hits (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Ranged Shrouding Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Ranged Shrouding.

specialRules.name: Crossing Attack
specialRules.description: Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and roll X dice. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.

specialRules.name: Strafing
specialRules.description: Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and attack it with this weapon as if it was shooting. This weapon may only be used in this way.

specialRules.name: Mind Control
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which must take a morale test. If failed you may move it by up to 6" in a straight line in any direction.

specialRules.name: Morale Debuff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to morale test rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Shatter
specialRules.description: Against units where most models have Tough(3) or higher, this weapon gets AP(+2).

specialRules.name: Precision Tag
specialRules.description: Once per game, during this model's activation, pick one enemy unit within 24" and in line of sight of it, and place X markers on it. When attacking, friendly units may remove markers from their target before rolling to hit to get +Y to hit rolls, where Y is the number of removed markers.

specialRules.name: Ignores Regeneration in Melee
specialRules.description: This model gets Ignores Regeneration in melee.

specialRules.name: Scrapper
specialRules.description: When attacking, targets must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6 when blocking hits from this model's weapons.

specialRules.name: Fortified
specialRules.description: When units where all models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Stealth Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Stealth.

specialRules.name: Vicious
specialRules.description: When attacking, targets must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6 when blocking hits from this model's weapons.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Shooter
specialRules.description: When shooting, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable
specialRules.description: When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Scout
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. After all other units are deployed, may be deployed anywhere fully within 12” of their deployment zone. Players alternate in placing Scout units, starting with the player that activates next.

specialRules.name: Ranged Shrouding
specialRules.description: Enemies get -6" range to a min. of 6" when trying to shoot units where all models have this rule.

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: This model must take X wounds before being killed. If a model with tough joins a unit without it, then it is removed last when the unit takes wounds. You must continue to put wounds on the tough model with most wounds in the unit until it is killed, before starting to put them on the next tough model (heroes must be assigned wounds last, even if already wounded).

specialRules.name: Ignores Regeneration
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration.

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where all models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Stealth
specialRules.description: When units where all models have this rule are shot from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Deadly
specialRules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.

specialRules.name: Point-Blank Surge
specialRules.description: When this model shoots at enemies within 12", unmodified results of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Spell Conduit
specialRules.description: Casters within 12" that are from other friendly units may cast spells as if they were in this model's position, and get +1 to casting rolls when doing so. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken.

specialRules.name: Unique
specialRules.description: This unit may only be taken once per army.

specialRules.name: Fast Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit moves +2" when using Advance actions and +4" when using Rush/Charge actions.

specialRules.name: Precision Target
specialRules.description: Once per game, during this model's activation, pick one enemy unit within 18" and in line of sight of it, and place X markers on it. Friendly units get +X to hit rolls when attacking it.

specialRules.name: Devout Boost
specialRules.description: If this model has Devout, when it shoots or charges enemies over 9" away, it deals extra hits on successful unmodified hit results of 5-6 from Devout (instead of only on 6).

specialRules.name: Piercing Hunter
specialRules.description: When this model shoots at enemies over 9" away, its weapons get AP(+1).

specialRules.name: Shielded
specialRules.description: Units where all models have this rule get +1 to defense rolls against hits that are not from spells.

specialRules.name: Courage Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to morale test rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Increased Shooting Range Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get +6" range when shooting.

specialRules.name: Regeneration Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Regeneration.

specialRules.name: Devout
specialRules.description: When attacking, unmodified results of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Fortified Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Fortified.

specialRules.name: Shred in Melee
specialRules.description: This model gets Shred in melee.

specialRules.name: Disintegrate
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and against units where most models have Defense 2+ to Defense 3+, this weapon gets AP(+2).

specialRules.name: Point-Blank Piercing Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Point-Blank Piercing.

specialRules.name: Precision Fighter Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to hit rolls in melee once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Shred in Melee Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Shred in melee.

specialRules.name: Guarded Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Guarded once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Courage Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get +1 to morale test rolls.

specialRules.name: Casting Debuff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight with Caster, which gets -1 to casting rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Fortified
specialRules.description: When units where all models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Piercing Assault
specialRules.description: This model gets AP(+1) when charging.

specialRules.name: Devout Boost Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Devout Boost.

specialRules.name: Precision Shooter Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to hit rolls when shooting once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Brutal
specialRules.description: When attacking, unmodified results of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Caster
specialRules.description: Gets X spell tokens at the start of each round, but can’t hold more than 6 tokens at once. At any point before attacking, spend as many tokens as the spell’s value to try casting one or more spells (only one try per spell). Roll one die, on 4+ resolve the effect on a target in line of sight. Models within 18” in line of sight of the caster’s unit may spend any number of spell tokens at the same time before rolling, to give the caster +1/-1 to the roll per token.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where all models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Shred
specialRules.description: On unmodified results of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.

specialRules.name: Ignores Regeneration
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Point-Blank Piercing
specialRules.description: This model gets AP(+1) when shooting enemies within 12".

specialRules.name: Guarded
specialRules.description: When units where all models have this rule are shot or charged from over 9" away, they get +1 to defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Blast
specialRules.description: Ignores cover, and after resolving other special rules, each hit is multiplied by X, where X is up to as many hits as models in the target unit.
